verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document selecting an element in the preview and directly editing its text, style, or layout. The documented iteration path is describing changes in chat or Build mode (docs-55, docs-4). Browsable, editable source code (docs-54) and local IDE editing via Git sync (docs-9) are adjacent workarounds, not visual direct-manipulation editing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip
